title: Correct coefficient of friction
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (1) must be μ = 0.5.

title: Correct velocity at C
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (2) must be v_C = 6 m/s.

title: Correct total time
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (3) must be t_total = 3 s.

title: Acceleration on conveyor belt
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply kinematics (v² = u² + 2as) or Newton's second law to find the block's acceleration on the belt as 5 m/s².

title: Acceleration on the slope
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Newton's second law on the incline, resolving forces to find the net acceleration as 2 m/s².

title: Time on each segment
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the time for each segment (belt, slope, ground) using appropriate kinematic equations.

title: Energy or sign error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assumes energy conservation where friction is present, or misassigns the sign/direction of acceleration on any segment.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution demonstrates consistent use of SI units (m, s, m/s²) throughout the calculation.
